name: Collar x Malice: The V-Day Incident!
summary:
On Valentine’s Day, Shinjuku police officer Ichika Hoshino receives a mysterious present! Who could it be from? Join Ichika and investigate alongside your favorites to solve the V-Day Incident once and for all!

Featuring routes for all main LIs, and a bonus route after completing all playthroughs!
This fangame is set after a modified version of Enomoto’s route in Collar x Malice, in which you’re not dating anyone. Estimated playtime is ~1.5 hours.
The 5 main routes contain minor spoilers for Collar x Malice; the bonus route contains full spoilers for CxM (and minor spoilers for Unlimited) - be warned!
This is a fanwork and labor of love not related in any way to Otomate; all rights reserved by them, etc
